BULLET_TIME.description: you cannot draw extra cards this turn; all cards in your hand cost 0 this turn. Upgrade: cost 2.
BULLET_TIME.name: Bullet Time
BULLET_TIME.zh_description: 3，技能，稀有，本回合不能额外抽牌；手牌全部费用为 0。升级：费用 2。

BULLY.description: deal damage = 4 + 2 per Vulnerable stack on the target. Upgrade: +1 per Vulnerable stack (3 each).
BULLY.name: Bully
BULLY.zh_description: 0，攻击，罕见，伤害 = 4 + 目标每层易伤 2 点。升级：每层易伤 3 点。

BULWARK.description: gain 12 Block; Forge 10. Upgrade: +3 Block, +3 Forge.
BULWARK.name: Bulwark
BULWARK.zh_description: 2，技能，罕见，获得 12 格挡；锻造 10。升级：格挡 +3、锻造 +3。

BUNDLE_OF_JOY.description: Exhaust, add 3 random Colorless cards to your hand. Upgrade: add 4.
BUNDLE_OF_JOY.name: Bundle Of Joy
BUNDLE_OF_JOY.zh_description: 1，技能，稀有，消耗，向手牌加入 3 张随机无色牌。升级：加入 4 张。

BURN.description: unplayable, status, status, in hand at end of turn take 2 damage. No upgrade.
BURN.name: Burn
BURN.zh_description: 无法打出，状态，状态，回合结束仍在手牌则受到 2 点伤害。无升级。

BURNING_PACT.description: Exhaust, exhaust a card; draw 2 cards. Upgrade: draw 3.
BURNING_PACT.name: Burning Pact
BURNING_PACT.zh_description: 1，技能，罕见，消耗，消耗 1 张牌；抽 2 张牌。升级：抽 3。

BURST.description: this turn your next Skill is played an extra time. Upgrade: next 2 Skills.
BURST.name: Burst
BURST.zh_description: 1，技能，稀有，本回合你的下一张技能牌额外打出一次。升级：下 2 张技能牌。

BURY.name: Bury
BURY.zh_description: 4，攻击，罕见，造成 52 点伤害。升级：伤害 +11。

BYRDONIS_EGG.description: unplayable, quest, quest, can be hatched at a Rest Site while in your deck. No upgrade.
BYRDONIS_EGG.name: Byrdonis Egg
BYRDONIS_EGG.zh_description: 无法打出，任务，任务，在牌组中时可在休息点孵化。无升级。

BYRD_SWOOP.name: Byrd Swoop
BYRD_SWOOP.zh_description: 0，攻击，事件，造成 14 点伤害。升级：伤害 +4。

CALAMITY.description: whenever you play an Attack add 1 random Attack from your class pool to your hand. Upgrade: cost 2.
CALAMITY.name: Calamity
CALAMITY.zh_description: 3，能力，稀有，每次打出攻击牌时向手牌加入 1 张职业池随机攻击牌。升级：费用 2。

CALCIFY.description: Osty's attacks deal 4 additional damage. Upgrade: +2 damage.
CALCIFY.name: Calcify
CALCIFY.zh_description: 1，能力，罕见，Osty 的攻击额外造成 4 点伤害。升级：额外 +2。

CALCULATED_GAMBLE.description: Exhaust, discard your hand then draw that many cards. Upgrade: gains Retain.
CALCULATED_GAMBLE.name: Calculated Gamble
CALCULATED_GAMBLE.zh_description: 0，技能，罕见，消耗，弃置全部手牌并抽取等量牌。升级：获得保留。

CALL_OF_THE_VOID.description: Ethereal, at start of your turn add 1 random card from your class pool (non-Basic/non-Ancient) to your hand; it gains Ethereal. Upgrade: gains Innate.
CALL_OF_THE_VOID.name: Call Of The Void
CALL_OF_THE_VOID.zh_description: 1，能力，稀有，虚无，回合开始向手牌加入 1 张职业池随机牌（非基础/远古）；其获得虚无。升级：获得固有。

CALTROPS.name: Caltrops
CALTROPS.zh_description: 1，能力，事件，获得 3 荆棘。升级：荆棘 +2。

CAPACITOR.description: gain 2 Orb Slots. Upgrade: gain 3 Orb Slots.
CAPACITOR.name: Capacitor
CAPACITOR.zh_description: 1，能力，罕见，获得 2 个充能球槽。升级：获得 3 个。

CAPTURE_SPIRIT.description: the enemy loses 3 HP (unblockable); add 3 Souls to your draw pile. Upgrade: +1 HP loss, +1 Soul.
CAPTURE_SPIRIT.name: Capture Spirit
CAPTURE_SPIRIT.zh_description: 1，技能，罕见，敌人失去 3 HP（无视格挡）；向抽牌堆加入 3 张灵魂。升级：HP 损失 +1、灵魂 +1。

CASCADE.description: play the top X cards of your draw pile. Upgrade: X+1 cards.
CASCADE.name: Cascade
CASCADE.zh_description: X，技能，稀有，打出抽牌堆顶 X 张牌。升级：X+1。

CATASTROPHE.description: auto-play 2 random cards from your draw pile. Upgrade: auto-play 3.
CATASTROPHE.name: Catastrophe
CATASTROPHE.zh_description: 2，技能，罕见，自动打出抽牌堆 2 张随机牌。升级：打出 3 张。

CELESTIAL_MIGHT.name: Celestial Might
CELESTIAL_MIGHT.zh_description: 2，攻击，普通，造成 6 点伤害 ×3 次。升级：4 次。

CHAOS.name: Chaos
CHAOS.zh_description: 1，技能，罕见，引导 1 个随机充能球。升级：引导 2 个。

CHARGE.description: transform 2 cards in your draw pile into MinionDiveBomb. Upgrade: transformed cards upgraded.
CHARGE.name: Charge
CHARGE.zh_description: 1，技能，罕见，将抽牌堆 2 张牌变为 MinionDiveBomb。升级：变化后的牌为升级版。

CHARGE_BATTERY.description: gain 7 Block; gain 1 Energy next turn. Upgrade: +3 Block.
CHARGE_BATTERY.name: Charge Battery
CHARGE_BATTERY.zh_description: 1，技能，普通，获得 7 格挡；下回合获得 1 能量。升级：格挡 +3。

CHILD_OF_THE_STARS.description: when you spend Stars gain 2 Block per Star spent. Upgrade: +3 Block per Star.
CHILD_OF_THE_STARS.name: Child Of The Stars
CHILD_OF_THE_STARS.zh_description: 1，能力，罕见，花费星星时每颗星获得 2 格挡。升级：每颗星 3 格挡。

CHILL.description: Exhaust, Channel 1 Frost for each enemy. Upgrade: removes Exhaust.
CHILL.name: Chill
CHILL.zh_description: 0，技能，罕见，消耗，每个敌人引导 1 个冰霜球。升级：移除消耗。

CINDER.description: Exhaust, deal 18 damage; exhaust a random card in your hand. Upgrade: +6 damage.
CINDER.name: Cinder
CINDER.zh_description: 2，攻击，普通，消耗，造成 18 点伤害；消耗手牌中 1 张随机牌。升级：伤害 +6。

CLASH.description: only playable if your hand is all Attacks; deal 14 damage. Upgrade: +4 damage.
CLASH.name: Clash
CLASH.zh_description: 0，攻击，事件，仅手牌全为攻击牌时可打出；造成 14 点伤害。升级：伤害 +4。

CLAW.description: deal 3 damage; ALL Claw cards deal +2 damage this combat (permanent per play). Upgrade: +1 damage, +1 increase.
CLAW.name: Claw
CLAW.zh_description: 0，攻击，普通，造成 3 点伤害；本场战斗所有 Claw 伤害永久 +2（每次打出叠加）。升级：伤害 +1、增量 +1。

CLEANSE.description: Exhaust, Summon 3; exhaust a card from your draw pile. Upgrade: Summon 5.
CLEANSE.name: Cleanse
CLEANSE.zh_description: 1，技能，罕见，消耗，召唤 3；消耗抽牌堆 1 张牌。升级：召唤 5。

CLOAK_AND_DAGGER.description: gain 6 Block; add 1 Shiv to your hand. Upgrade: add 2 Shivs.
CLOAK_AND_DAGGER.name: Cloak And Dagger
CLOAK_AND_DAGGER.zh_description: 1，技能，普通，获得 6 格挡；向手牌加入 1 张 Shiv。升级：加入 2 张。

CLOAK_OF_STARS.name: Cloak Of Stars
CLOAK_OF_STARS.zh_description: 0，技能，普通，获得 7 格挡。升级：格挡 +3。

CLUMSY.description: unplayable, curse, curse, Ethereal, no effect. No upgrade.
CLUMSY.name: Clumsy
CLUMSY.zh_description: 无法打出，诅咒，诅咒，虚无，无效果。无升级。

COLD_SNAP.description: deal 6 damage; Channel 1 Frost. Upgrade: +3 damage.
COLD_SNAP.name: Cold Snap
COLD_SNAP.zh_description: 1，攻击，普通，造成 6 点伤害；引导 1 个冰霜球。升级：伤害 +3。

COLLISION_COURSE.description: deal 11 damage; add a Debris to your hand. Upgrade: +4 damage.
COLLISION_COURSE.name: Collision Course
COLLISION_COURSE.zh_description: 0，攻击，普通，造成 11 点伤害；向手牌加入 1 张碎屑。升级：伤害 +4。

COLOSSUS.description: gain 5 Block; gain Colossus 1 — attacks from Vulnerable enemies deal 50% damage to you (decrements at end of enemy turn). Upgrade: +3 Block.
COLOSSUS.name: Colossus
COLOSSUS.zh_description: 1，技能，罕见，获得 5 格挡；获得巨像 1——本回合易伤敌人对你造成的攻击伤害 -50%（敌方回合结束递减）。升级：格挡 +3。

COMET.description: deal 33 damage; apply 3 Weak; apply 3 Vulnerable. Upgrade: +11 damage.
COMET.name: Comet
COMET.zh_description: 0，攻击，稀有，造成 33 点伤害；施加 3 层虚弱；施加 3 层易伤。升级：伤害 +11。

COMPACT.description: gain 6 Block; transform Status cards in your hand into Fuel. Upgrade: +1 Block; Fuel upgraded.
COMPACT.name: Compact
COMPACT.zh_description: 1，技能，罕见，获得 6 格挡；将手牌中的状态牌变为 Fuel。升级：格挡 +1；Fuel 为升级版。

COMPILE_DRIVER.description: deal 7 damage; draw 1 card per unique Orb type Channeled. Upgrade: +3 damage.
COMPILE_DRIVER.name: Compile Driver
COMPILE_DRIVER.zh_description: 1，攻击，普通，造成 7 点伤害；每种充能球类型抽 1 张牌。升级：伤害 +3。

CONFLAGRATION.description: deal 2 damage to ALL enemies 4 times. Upgrade: 5 hits.
CONFLAGRATION.name: Conflagration
CONFLAGRATION.zh_description: 1，攻击，稀有，对所有敌人造成 2 点伤害 ×4 次。升级：5 次。

CONQUEROR.description: Forge 3; Sovereign Blade deals double damage to the target this turn. Upgrade: Forge 5.
CONQUEROR.name: Conqueror
CONQUEROR.zh_description: 1，技能，罕见，锻造 3；本回合君主之刃对该敌伤害翻倍。升级：锻造 5。

CONSUMING_SHADOW.description: Channel 2 Dark; at end of your turn Evoke your last Orb 1 time. Upgrade: Channel 3 Dark.
CONSUMING_SHADOW.name: Consuming Shadow
CONSUMING_SHADOW.zh_description: 2，能力，稀有，引导 2 个暗球；回合结束激发最末（最右）充能球 1 次。升级：引导 3 个暗球。

CONVERGENCE.description: Retain, next turn gain 1 Energy and 1 Star; retain your hand this turn. Upgrade: +2 Stars next turn.
CONVERGENCE.name: Convergence
CONVERGENCE.zh_description: 1，技能，罕见，保留，下回合获得 1 能量与 1 颗星；本回合保留手牌。升级：下回合 2 颗星。

COOLANT.description: at start of your turn gain 2 Block per unique Orb type Channeled. Upgrade: +3 Block per type.
COOLANT.name: Coolant
COOLANT.zh_description: 1，能力，稀有，回合开始每种充能球类型获得 2 格挡。升级：每种 3 格挡。

COOLHEADED.description: Channel 1 Frost; draw 1 card. Upgrade: draw 2.
COOLHEADED.name: Coolheaded
COOLHEADED.zh_description: 1，技能，普通，引导 1 个冰霜球；抽 1 张牌。升级：抽 2。

COORDINATE.description: another player gains 5 Strength this turn. Upgrade: +3 Strength.
COORDINATE.name: Coordinate
COORDINATE.zh_description: 1，技能，罕见，另一名玩家本回合获得 5 力量。升级：力量 +3。

CORROSIVE_WAVE.description: this turn whenever you draw a card apply 2 Poison to ALL enemies. Upgrade: 3 Poison.
CORROSIVE_WAVE.name: Corrosive Wave
CORROSIVE_WAVE.zh_description: 1，技能，稀有，本回合每抽一张牌对所有敌人施加 2 层中毒。升级：3 层。

CORRUPTION.description: Exhaust, your Skills cost 0 and are Exhausted when played. Upgrade: cost 2.
CORRUPTION.name: Corruption
CORRUPTION.zh_description: 3，能力，远古，消耗，你的技能牌费用变为 0，打出时被消耗。升级：费用 2。

COSMIC_INDIFFERENCE.description: gain 6 Block; place a card from your discard pile on top of your draw pile. Upgrade: +3 Block.
COSMIC_INDIFFERENCE.name: Cosmic Indifference
COSMIC_INDIFFERENCE.zh_description: 1，技能，普通，获得 6 格挡；将弃牌堆 1 张牌放到抽牌堆顶。升级：格挡 +3。

COUNTDOWN.description: at start of your turn apply 6 Doom to a random enemy. Upgrade: +3 Doom.
COUNTDOWN.name: Countdown
COUNTDOWN.zh_description: 1，能力，罕见，回合开始对随机敌人施加 6 层末日。升级：末日 +3。

CRASH_LANDING.description: deal 21 damage to ALL enemies; fill your hand with Debris. Upgrade: +5 damage.
CRASH_LANDING.name: Crash Landing
CRASH_LANDING.zh_description: 1，攻击，稀有，对所有敌人造成 21 点伤害；用手牌填满碎屑。升级：伤害 +5。

CREATIVE_AI.description: at start of your turn add 1 random Power from your class pool to your hand. Upgrade: cost 2.
CREATIVE_AI.name: Creative Ai
CREATIVE_AI.zh_description: 3，能力，稀有，回合开始向手牌加入 1 张职业池随机能力牌。升级：费用 2。

CRESCENT_SPEAR.description: deal damage = 8 + 2 per card you own with a Star cost. Upgrade: +1 per Star-cost card.

CRESCENT_SPEAR.zh_description: 1，攻击，普通，伤害 = 8 + 你拥有的每张星费牌 2 点。升级：每张 +3。

CRIMSON_MANTLE.description: at start of your turn lose 1 HP (unblockable) and gain 8 Block. Upgrade: +2 Block.
CRIMSON_MANTLE.name: Crimson Mantle
CRIMSON_MANTLE.zh_description: 1，能力，稀有，回合开始失去 1 HP（无视格挡）并获得 8 格挡。升级：格挡 +2。

CRUELTY.description: Vulnerable enemies take +25% attack damage from you. Upgrade: +50% total.
CRUELTY.name: Cruelty
CRUELTY.zh_description: 1，能力，稀有，易伤敌人受到你的攻击伤害额外 +25%。升级：总计 +50%。

CRUSH_UNDER.description: deal 7 damage to ALL enemies; they lose 1 Strength this turn. Upgrade: +1 damage, lose 2 Strength.
CRUSH_UNDER.name: Crush Under
CRUSH_UNDER.zh_description: 1，攻击，普通，对所有敌人造成 7 点伤害；本回合其失去 1 力量。升级：伤害 +1、失去 2 力量。

CURSE_OF_THE_BELL.description: unplayable, curse, curse, Eternal, no effect. No upgrade.

CURSE_OF_THE_BELL.zh_description: 无法打出，诅咒，诅咒，永恒，无效果。无升级。

DAGGER_SPRAY.description: deal 4 damage to ALL enemies twice. Upgrade: +2 damage.
DAGGER_SPRAY.name: Dagger Spray
DAGGER_SPRAY.zh_description: 1，攻击，普通，对所有敌人造成 4 点伤害 ×2。升级：伤害 +2。

DAGGER_THROW.description: deal 9 damage; draw 1 card; discard 1 card. Upgrade: +3 damage.
DAGGER_THROW.name: Dagger Throw
DAGGER_THROW.zh_description: 1，攻击，普通，造成 9 点伤害；抽 1 张牌；弃 1 张牌。升级：伤害 +3。

DANSE_MACABRE.description: whenever you play a card costing 2 or more gain 4 Block. Upgrade: +2 Block.
DANSE_MACABRE.name: Danse Macabre
DANSE_MACABRE.zh_description: 1，能力，罕见，打出费用 2 及以上的卡牌时获得 4 格挡。升级：格挡 +2。

DARKNESS.description: Channel 1 Dark; trigger the passive of all your Dark Orbs 1 time. Upgrade: 2 times.
DARKNESS.name: Darkness
DARKNESS.zh_description: 1，技能，罕见，引导 1 个暗球；触发你所有暗球的被动 1 次。升级：2 次。

DARK_EMBRACE.description: Exhaust, whenever a card is Exhausted draw 1 card. Upgrade: cost 1.
DARK_EMBRACE.name: Dark Embrace
DARK_EMBRACE.zh_description: 2，能力，稀有，消耗，每次有卡牌被消耗时抽 1 张牌。升级：费用 1。

DARK_SHACKLES.description: Exhaust, the enemy loses 9 Strength this turn. Upgrade: lose 15 Strength.
DARK_SHACKLES.name: Dark Shackles
DARK_SHACKLES.zh_description: 0，技能，罕见，消耗，敌人本回合失去 9 力量。升级：失去 15 力量。

DASH.description: gain 10 Block; deal 10 damage. Upgrade: +3 damage, +3 Block.
DASH.name: Dash
DASH.zh_description: 2，攻击，罕见，获得 10 格挡；造成 10 点伤害。升级：伤害 +3、格挡 +3。

DAZED.description: unplayable, status, status, Ethereal, no effect. No upgrade.
DAZED.name: Dazed
DAZED.zh_description: 无法打出，状态，状态，虚无，无效果。无升级。

DEADLY_POISON.name: Deadly Poison
DEADLY_POISON.zh_description: 1，技能，普通，施加 5 层中毒。升级：中毒 +2。

DEATHBRINGER.description: apply 21 Doom and 1 Weak to ALL enemies. Upgrade: +5 Doom.
DEATHBRINGER.name: Deathbringer
DEATHBRINGER.zh_description: 2，技能，罕见，对所有敌人施加 21 层末日与 1 层虚弱。升级：末日 +5。

DEATHS_DOOR.description: gain 6 Block; if Doom was applied this turn gain the Block 2 additional times. Upgrade: +1 Block.
DEATHS_DOOR.name: Deaths Door
DEATHS_DOOR.zh_description: 1，技能，罕见，获得 6 格挡；本回合施加过末日则格挡再触发 2 次。升级：格挡 +1。

DEATH_MARCH.description: deal damage = 8 + 4 per card you drew this turn (excluding hand-draw). Upgrade: +1 base, +2 per card.
DEATH_MARCH.name: Death March
DEATH_MARCH.zh_description: 1，攻击，罕见，伤害 = 8 + 本回合每抽过一张牌（不含回合抽牌）4 点。升级：基础 +1、每张 +2。

DEBILITATE.description: deal 10 damage; for 2 turns the target's Vulnerable and Weak effects are doubled. Upgrade: +2 damage, 3 turns.
DEBILITATE.name: Debilitate
DEBILITATE.zh_description: 1，攻击，罕见，造成 10 点伤害；2 回合内目标的易伤与虚弱效果翻倍。升级：伤害 +2、持续 3 回合。

DEBRIS.description: Exhaust, no effect when played. No upgrade.
DEBRIS.name: Debris
DEBRIS.zh_description: 1，状态，状态，消耗，打出无效果。无升级。

DECAY.description: unplayable, curse, curse, in hand at end of turn take 2 unpowered damage. No upgrade.
DECAY.name: Decay
DECAY.zh_description: 无法打出，诅咒，诅咒，回合结束仍在手牌则受到 2 点无来源伤害。无升级。

DECISIONS_DECISIONS.name: Decisions Decisions
DECISIONS_DECISIONS.zh_description: 0，技能，稀有，消耗，抽 3 张牌；将所选技能牌打出 3 次（重放不消耗能量 —— 例如 3×壁垒 = 单动作 36 格挡 + 30 锻造）。除 0 能量标签外另需星费 —— 星不足时 bridge 报 `StarCostTooHigh`（星星储蓄后可打，如天赋君权/崇敬之后）。升级：抽 5。

DEFEND_DEFECT.name: Defend Defect
DEFEND_DEFECT.zh_description: 1，技能，基础，获得 5 格挡。升级：格挡 +3。

DEFEND_IRONCLAD.name: Defend Ironclad
DEFEND_IRONCLAD.zh_description: 1，技能，基础，获得 5 格挡。升级：格挡 +3。

DEFEND_NECROBINDER.name: Defend Necrobinder
DEFEND_NECROBINDER.zh_description: 1，技能，基础，获得 5 格挡。升级：格挡 +3。

DEFEND_REGENT.name: Defend Regent
DEFEND_REGENT.zh_description: 1，技能，基础，获得 5 格挡。升级：格挡 +3。

DEFEND_SILENT.name: Defend Silent
DEFEND_SILENT.zh_description: 1，技能，基础，获得 5 格挡。升级：格挡 +3。

DEFLECT.zh_description: 0，技能，普通，获得 4 格挡。升级：格挡 +3。

DEFRAGMENT.name: Defragment

DODGE_AND_ROLL.description: gain 4 Block; next turn gain 4 Block. Upgrade: +2 Block both.

DODGE_AND_ROLL.zh_description: 1，技能，普通，获得 4 格挡；下回合获得 4 格挡。升级：各 +2。

DOUBLE_ENERGY.description: Exhaust, double your current Energy. Upgrade: cost 0.

DRUM_OF_BATTLE.description: Exhaust, draw 2 cards; when this card is Exhausted gain 2 Energy. Upgrade: gain 3 Energy on Exhaust. Exhaust-refund rule: self-exhaust on play does NOT refund (playing it directly showed net −1 Energy +2 draw with no refund); external exhaust by another card's effect (Second Wind / Burning Pact class) DOES refund — Second Wind exhausting Drum from hand raised energy 3→4 the same moment. DUALCAST.zh_description: 1，技能，基础，激发最末充能球两次。升级：费用 0。

DYING_STAR.description: Ethereal, deal 9 damage to ALL enemies; all enemies lose 9 Strength this turn. Upgrade: +2 damage, lose 11 Strength.

DYING_STAR.zh_description: 1，攻击，稀有，虚无，对所有敌人造成 9 点伤害；所有敌人本回合失去 9 力量。升级：伤害 +2、失去 11 力量。

ECHO_FORM.description: Ethereal, the first card you play each turn is played an extra time. Upgrade: removes Ethereal.

ECHO_FORM.zh_description: 3，能力，稀有，虚无，每回合打出的第一张牌重复打出。升级：移除虚无。

EIDOLON.description: Exhaust, exhaust your hand; if 9 or more cards were Exhausted gain 1 Intangible. Upgrade: cost 1.

EIDOLON.zh_description: 2，技能，稀有，消耗，消耗全部手牌；若消耗 9 张及以上获得 1 层虚无（Intangible）。升级：费用 1。

END_OF_DAYS.description: apply 29 Doom to ALL enemies; enemies whose Doom >= their HP die. Upgrade: +8 Doom.
END_OF_DAYS.name: End Of Days
END_OF_DAYS.zh_description: 3，技能，稀有，对所有敌人施加 29 层末日；末日 ≥ HP 的敌人直接死亡。升级：末日 +8。

ENERGY_SURGE.description: Exhaust, ALL players gain 2 Energy. Upgrade: gain 3 Energy.

ENERGY_SURGE.zh_description: 1，技能，罕见，消耗，所有玩家获得 2 能量。升级：获得 3 能量。

ENFEEBLING_TOUCH.description: Ethereal, the enemy loses 8 Strength this turn. Upgrade: lose 11 Strength.

ENTRENCH.zh_description: 2，技能，事件，获得等同你当前格挡值的格挡。升级：费用 1。

ENTROPY.description: at start of your turn transform 1 card in your hand at random. Upgrade: gains Innate.

ENTROPY.zh_description: 1，能力，稀有，回合开始随机变形手牌 1 张牌。升级：获得固有。

ENVENOM.description: unblocked Attack damage you deal applies 1 Poison. Upgrade: 2 Poison.
ENVENOM.name: Envenom
ENVENOM.zh_description: 2，能力，稀有，你造成的未被格挡的攻击伤害施加 1 层中毒。升级：2 层。

ETERNAL_ARMOR.name: Eternal Armor
ETERNAL_ARMOR.zh_description: 3，能力，稀有，获得 9 镀甲。升级：镀甲 +3。

EVIL_EYE.description: Exhaust, gain 8 Block; if you Exhausted a card this turn, gain the Block twice (16 total). Upgrade: +3 Block. Evil Eye's own Exhaust does NOT count for the double trigger — another card must be exhausted earlier the same turn (Tremble/Offering/Bloodletting-with-exhaust etc.); played alone it grants 8, played after a prior Exhaust it grants 16. Build anomaly: EvilEye's own disposal does NOT increment the exhaust pile count — the card lands in discard (discard +1, exhaust unchanged); treat EvilEye self-disposal as discard-class for exhaust-pile accounting; the double-block condition still fires correctly off PRIOR exhausts (TOXIC/TrueGrit/Purity plays); FnP/Juggernaut do not proc off EvilEye itself.

ITERATION.description: the first Status card you draw each turn draws 2 additional cards. Upgrade: draw 3 additional.

I_AM_INVINCIBLE.name: I Am Invincible
I_AM_INVINCIBLE.zh_description: 1，技能，稀有，获得 10 格挡。升级：格挡 +3。

JACKPOT.description: deal 25 damage; add 3 random 0-cost cards from your class pool to your hand. Upgrade: +5 damage; cards upgraded. JACK_OF_ALL_TRADES.description: Exhaust, add 1 random Colorless card to your hand. Upgrade: add 2.

JUGGERNAUT.name: Juggernaut

Damage instance 6 is below HardToKill-9 cap (full value vs Exoskeleton-class).

KINGLY_KICK.name: Kingly Kick

KINGLY_PUNCH.zh_description: 1，攻击，罕见，造成 8 点伤害；本场战斗每抽到此牌一次其伤害永久 +4。升级：伤害 +2、增量 +2。

KNOCKOUT_BLOW.description: deal 30 damage; if Fatal gain 5 Stars. Upgrade: +8 damage.

KNOCKOUT_BLOW.zh_description: 3，攻击，罕见，造成 30 点伤害；击杀则获得 5 颗星。升级：伤害 +8。

KNOW_THY_PLACE.description: Exhaust, apply 1 Weak; apply 1 Vulnerable. Upgrade: removes Exhaust.
KNOW_THY_PLACE.name: Know Thy Place

MAYHEM.description: at the pre-play phase auto-play the top card of your draw pile. Upgrade: cost 1.
MAYHEM.name: Mayhem
MAYHEM.zh_description: 2，能力，稀有，预打出阶段自动打出抽牌堆顶牌。升级：费用 1。

MINION_SACRIFICE.name: Minion Sacrifice

LIVE runs 38+40: on Vuln-2 target dealt 15-class (10×1.5) and stacks doubled 2→4; at 0 Vuln applies 0 and does not consume enemy Artifact. Order doctrine: Bash/Tremble/Uppercut first, Molten Fist second — value is the stack double.
MOLTEN_FIST.name: Molten Fist
MOLTEN_FIST.upgrade: +4 damage. On a target with 0 Vulnerable stacks it applies 0 Vuln (doubles zero) AND does not consume an enemy Artifact stack — no debuff event is generated at 0 stacks (an Artifact 2 stack stays 2). Value is wasted on un-Vulned/Artifact targets: apply Vuln first (Bash/Thunderclap), MoltenFist after.
MOLTEN_FIST.zh_description: 消耗，造成 10 点伤害；施加等同目标当前易伤层数的易伤（翻倍）。升级：+4 伤害。run-38 实时：对 Vuln-2 目标造成 15（10×1.5）且层数翻至 4；Vuln-4 时 15 伤 + 层数继续叠加（实时 Bash→MoltenFist 序列显示 2→4→6）。对 0 层易伤目标施加 0 且不消耗敌方 Artifact。顺序教条：先 Bash/Tremble，后熔岩拳——价值在翻倍而非那 10 点。

NORMALITY.name: Normality
NORMALITY.zh_description: 无法打出，诅咒，诅咒，在手牌中时每回合最多打出 3 张牌。无升级。

NOSTALGIA.description: the first 1 Attack/Skill you play each turn goes to the top of your draw pile instead of your discard pile. Upgrade: cost 0.
NOSTALGIA.name: Nostalgia
NOSTALGIA.zh_description: 1，能力，稀有，每回合你打出的第一张攻击/技能牌置入抽牌堆顶而非弃牌堆。升级：费用 0。

NOT_YET.description: Exhaust, heal 10 HP. Upgrade: heal 13 HP. The +10 HP heal fires in-combat — emergency sustain for HP-starved lines; stacks same-turn with TuningFork skill-count block.
NOT_YET.name: Not Yet
NOT_YET.upgrade: heal 13 HP. The +10 HP heal fires in-combat — emergency sustain for HP-starved lines; stacks same-turn with TuningFork skill-count block.
NOT_YET.zh_description: 2，技能，稀有，消耗，回复 10 HP。升级：回复 13 HP。+10 HP 治疗在战斗内生效，HP 危机局的应急续航件；与音叉（技能计数挡）同回合可叠加。

NOXIOUS_FUMES.description: at start of your turn apply 2 Poison to ALL enemies. Upgrade: +3 Poison.
NOXIOUS_FUMES.name: Noxious Fumes
NOXIOUS_FUMES.zh_description: 1，能力，罕见，回合开始对所有敌人施加 2 层中毒。升级：3 层。

NO_ESCAPE.description: apply Doom = 10 + 5 per each full 10 Doom already on the target. Upgrade: base 15.
NO_ESCAPE.name: No Escape
NO_ESCAPE.zh_description: 1，技能，罕见，施加末日 = 10 + 目标每已有完整 10 层末日再 +5。升级：基础 15。

NULL.description: deal 10 damage; apply 2 Weak; Channel 1 Dark. Upgrade: +3 damage, +1 Weak.
NULL.name: Null
NULL.zh_description: 2，攻击，罕见，造成 10 点伤害；施加 2 层虚弱；引导 1 个暗球。升级：伤害 +3、虚弱 +1。

OBLIVION.description: apply Oblivion 3 to the enemy — whenever you play a card apply 3 Doom to it. Upgrade: +1 Doom per card.
OBLIVION.name: Oblivion
OBLIVION.zh_description: 0，技能，稀有，对敌人施加湮灭 3——你每打出一张牌对其施加 3 层末日。升级：每张 +4。

OFFERING.description: Exhaust, lose 6 HP (unblockable); gain 2 Energy; draw 3 cards. Upgrade: draw 5.
OFFERING.name: Offering
OFFERING.zh_description: 0，技能，稀有，消耗，失去 6 HP（无视格挡）；获得 2 能量；抽 3 张牌。升级：抽 5。

OMNISLICE.description: deal 8 damage to the target; other enemies of the target take equal damage. Upgrade: +3 damage.
OMNISLICE.name: Omnislice
OMNISLICE.zh_description: 0，攻击，罕见，对目标造成 8 点伤害；目标的其他敌人受到等量伤害。升级：伤害 +3。

ONE_TWO_PUNCH.description: the next Attack you play this turn is played an extra time. Upgrade: extra 2 Attacks. Upgraded ONE_TWO_PUNCH adds the next attack 2 extra times (3 total resolutions — Strike×3 can wipe 21-48 HP adds in one play); Dominate Strength math: on a 0-Vuln target grants roughly +1~2 Strength (applying 1 Vuln), on a target already carrying Vuln stacks the Strength gain equals the post-application stack count — Bash (2 Vuln) then DOMINATE = ~+3 Strength.
ONE_TWO_PUNCH.name: One Two Punch
ONE_TWO_PUNCH.upgrade: extra 2 Attacks. Upgraded ONE_TWO_PUNCH adds the next attack 2 extra times (3 total resolutions — Strike×3 can wipe 21-48 HP adds in one play); Dominate Strength math: on a 0-Vuln target grants roughly +1~2 Strength (applying 1 Vuln), on a target already carrying Vuln stacks the Strength gain equals the post-application stack count — Bash (2 Vuln) then DOMINATE = ~+3 Strength.
ONE_TWO_PUNCH.zh_description: 1，技能，稀有，本回合你打出的下一张攻击牌额外打出一次。升级：额外 2 次。 升级版 ONE_TWO_PUNCH 使下一张攻击牌额外打出 2 次（共 3 次结算——单次 Strike×3 可清掉 21-48 HP 召唤物）；DOMINATE 力量算式：对 0 易伤目标约 +1~2 力量（施加 1 层易伤时），对已带易伤层数的目标，力量获取=施加后层数——Bash（2 易伤）→ DOMINATE ≈ +3 力量。

ORBIT.description: every 4 Energy you spend gain 1 Energy. Upgrade: cost 1.
ORBIT.name: Orbit
ORBIT.zh_description: 2，能力，罕见，每花费 4 能量获得 1 能量。升级：费用 1。

OUTBREAK.description: every 3rd time you apply Poison deal 11 damage to ALL enemies. Upgrade: deal 15 damage.
OUTBREAK.name: Outbreak
OUTBREAK.zh_description: 1，能力，罕见，每第 3 次施加中毒时对所有敌人造成 11 点伤害。升级：造成 15 点。

OUTMANEUVER.description: gain 2 Energy next turn. Upgrade: gain 3.
OUTMANEUVER.name: Outmaneuver
OUTMANEUVER.zh_description: 1，技能，事件，下回合获得 2 能量。升级：获得 3 能量。

OVERCLOCK.description: draw 2 cards; add a Burn to your discard pile. Upgrade: draw 3.
OVERCLOCK.name: Overclock
OVERCLOCK.zh_description: 0，技能，罕见，抽 2 张牌；向弃牌堆加入 1 张燃烧。升级：抽 3。

PACTS_END.description: 0-cost Attack, deal 17 damage to ALL enemies; ONLY deals damage if your exhaust pile has at least 3 cards. Upgrade: +6. LIVE run-38: at exhaust=3 dealt 17 AoE (slime-quartet: 26→9 / 33→16 / 1-HP kill); at exhaust<3 played legal but dealt 0 — condition gate real. Exhaust threshold met naturally by Offering+Ritual+Tremble/MoltenFist chains mid-fight. Also counts as an Attack for Nunchaku even when the condition whiffs.
PACTS_END.name: Pacts End
PACTS_END.zh_description: 0 费攻击，对所有敌人造成 17 点伤害；仅当消耗堆至少 3 张牌时造成伤害。升级：+6。run-38 实时：exhaust=3 时 17 AoE（四史莱姆：26→9 / 33→16 / 1 HP 补刀）；exhaust<3 时打出合法但 0 伤——条件闸门真实。Offering+Ritual+Tremble/MoltenFist 链在战斗中段自然凑满阈值。条件未满足时打出仍计入 Nunchaku 攻击数。

PAGESTORM.description: Ethereal, whenever you draw an Ethereal card draw 1 additional card. Upgrade: cost 0.
PAGESTORM.name: Pagestorm
PAGESTORM.zh_description: 1，能力，罕见，虚无，抽到虚无牌时额外抽 1 张牌。升级：费用 0。

PALE_BLUE_DOT.description: if you played 5 or more cards last turn, draw 1 additional card this turn. Upgrade: draw 2 additional.
PALE_BLUE_DOT.name: Pale Blue Dot
PALE_BLUE_DOT.zh_description: 1，能力，罕见，若上回合打出 5 张及以上卡牌，本回合多抽 1 张牌。升级：多抽 2 张。

PANACHE.description: every 5 cards you play deal 10 damage to ALL enemies. Upgrade: deal 14 damage. Procs cleanly on 5-card turns after deployment (10 AoE on multi-part enemies); the DEPLOY turn itself may not proc at the 5th card played — either the deploy card is excluded from the count or the counter starts post-deploy. Plan proc math from the turn AFTER deploy.

PANACHE.zh_description: 0，能力，罕见，每打出 5 张牌对所有敌人造成 10 点伤害。升级：造成 14 点。部署后的 5 卡回合干净触发（多部位敌人可见 10 AoE）；**部署当回合**第 5 张牌可能不触发——或部署牌自身不计入，或计数自部署后起算。proc 数学从部署次回合起规划。

PANIC_BUTTON.description: Exhaust, gain 30 Block; for 2 turns your card-sourced Block gains are 0. Upgrade: +10 Block.
PANIC_BUTTON.name: Panic Button
PANIC_BUTTON.zh_description: 0，技能，罕见，消耗，获得 30 格挡；2 回合内你的卡牌格挡来源为 0。升级：格挡 +10。

PARRY.description: gain 10 Parry (Sovereign Blade scales with Parry). Upgrade: +4 Parry.
PARRY.name: Parry
PARRY.zh_description: 1，能力，罕见，获得 10 招架（君主之刃随招架强化）。升级：招架 +4。

PARSE.name: Parse
PARSE.zh_description: 1，技能，罕见，虚无，抽 3 张牌。升级：抽 4。

PARTICLE_WALL.description:
Gain 9 Block.
Return this card to your Hand.
PARTICLE_WALL.name: Particle Wall
PARTICLE_WALL.zh_description: 0，技能，罕见，获得 9 格挡。升级：格挡 +3。

PATTER.description: gain 8 Block; gain 2 Vigor. Upgrade: +2 Block, +1 Vigor.
PATTER.name: Patter
PATTER.zh_description: 1，技能，普通，获得 8 格挡；获得 2 活力。升级：格挡 +2、活力 +1。

PECK.name: Peck
PECK.zh_description: 1，攻击，事件，造成 2 点伤害 ×3 次。升级：4 次。

PERFECTED_STRIKE.description: Strike-tagged, deal damage = 6 + 2 for each Strike-tagged card you own. Upgrade: +3 per Strike. LIVE (run-36): formula confirmed — with 7-9 Strike-tags in deck plus player Strength plus StrikeDummy +3 (Dummy applies before Vuln multiplier), resolves 23–30 class; TwinStrike copies each add a tag (+2 PS base each).
PERFECTED_STRIKE.name: Perfected Strike
PERFECTED_STRIKE.upgrade: +3 per Strike. LIVE (run-36): formula confirmed — with 7-9 Strike-tags in deck plus player Strength plus StrikeDummy +3 (Dummy applies before Vuln multiplier), resolves 23–30 class; TwinStrike copies each add a tag (+2 PS base each).
PERFECTED_STRIKE.zh_description: 2，攻击，普通，打击标签，伤害 = 6 + 你拥有的每张打击标签牌 2 点。升级：每张 3 点。LIVE（对局 36）：公式确认——牌组 7–9 张打击标签 + 玩家力量 + STRIKE_DUMMY +3（假人作用于易伤乘区之前）时结算 23–30 级；TwinStrike 拷贝各带一张标签（PS 基值每张 +2）。

PHANTOM_BLADES.description: Retain, your Shivs gain Retain and deal +9 damage. Upgrade: +12 damage.
PHANTOM_BLADES.name: Phantom Blades
PHANTOM_BLADES.zh_description: 1，能力，罕见，保留，你的 Shiv 获得保留并额外造成 9 点伤害。升级：额外 12 点。

PHOTON_CUT.description: deal 10 damage; draw 1 card; put a card from your hand on top of your draw pile. Upgrade: +3 damage, draw 2.
PHOTON_CUT.name: Photon Cut
PHOTON_CUT.zh_description: 1，攻击，普通，造成 10 点伤害；抽 1 张牌；将手牌 1 张牌放到抽牌堆顶。升级：伤害 +3、抽 2。

PIERCING_WAIL.description: Exhaust, ALL enemies lose 6 Strength this turn. Upgrade: lose 8 Strength.
PIERCING_WAIL.name: Piercing Wail
PIERCING_WAIL.zh_description: 1，技能，普通，消耗，本回合所有敌人失去 6 力量。升级：失去 8 力量。

PILLAGE.description: deal 6 damage; then draw cards, repeating while each drawn card is an Attack and your hand is not full. Upgrade: +3 damage.
PILLAGE.name: Pillage
PILLAGE.zh_description: 1，攻击，罕见，造成 6 点伤害；随后抽牌，若抽到的牌是攻击牌且手牌未满则继续抽。升级：伤害 +3。

PILLAR_OF_CREATION.description: whenever a card is generated for you gain 3 Block. Upgrade: +4 Block.
PILLAR_OF_CREATION.name: Pillar Of Creation
PILLAR_OF_CREATION.zh_description: 1，能力，罕见，每次为你生成卡牌时获得 3 格挡。升级：格挡 +4。

PINPOINT.name: Pinpoint
PINPOINT.zh_description: 3，攻击，罕见，造成 15 点伤害。升级：伤害 +4。

POISONED_STAB.description: deal 6 damage; apply 3 Poison. Upgrade: +2 damage, +1 Poison.
POISONED_STAB.name: Poisoned Stab
POISONED_STAB.zh_description: 1，攻击，普通，造成 6 点伤害；施加 3 层中毒。升级：伤害 +2、中毒 +1。

POKE.description: Osty-attack, Osty deals 6 damage. Upgrade: Osty +3 damage.
POKE.name: Poke
POKE.zh_description: 0，攻击，普通，Osty 攻击，Osty 造成 6 点伤害。升级：Osty 伤害 +3。

POMMEL_STRIKE.description: Strike-tagged, deal 9 damage; draw 1 card. Upgrade: +1 damage, draw 2.
POMMEL_STRIKE.name: Pommel Strike
POMMEL_STRIKE.zh_description: 1，攻击，普通，打击标签，造成 9 点伤害；抽 1 张牌。升级：伤害 +1、抽 2。

POOR_SLEEP.description: unplayable, curse, curse, Retain, no effect. No upgrade.
POOR_SLEEP.name: Poor Sleep
POOR_SLEEP.zh_description: 无法打出，诅咒，诅咒，保留，无效果。无升级。

POUNCE.description: deal 14 damage; your next Skill costs 0. Upgrade: +6 damage.
POUNCE.name: Pounce
POUNCE.zh_description: 2，攻击，罕见，造成 14 点伤害；你的下一张技能牌费用为 0。升级：伤害 +6。

PRECISE_CUT.description: deal damage = 13 - 2 per other card in your hand (1 card counted less if this is in hand). Upgrade: +3 base.
PRECISE_CUT.name: Precise Cut
PRECISE_CUT.zh_description: 0，攻击，罕见，伤害 = 13 - 手牌中其他每张牌 2 点。升级：基础 +3。

PREDATOR.description: deal 15 damage; draw 2 cards next turn. Upgrade: +5 damage.
PREDATOR.name: Predator
PREDATOR.zh_description: 2，攻击，普通，造成 15 点伤害；下回合抽 2 张牌。升级：伤害 +5。

PREPARED.description: draw 1 card; discard 1 card. Upgrade: draw 2, discard 2.
PREPARED.name: Prepared
PREPARED.zh_description: 0，技能，普通，抽 1 张牌；弃 1 张牌。升级：抽 2 弃 2。

PREP_TIME.description: at start of your turn gain 4 Vigor. Upgrade: +2 Vigor.
PREP_TIME.name: Prep Time
PREP_TIME.zh_description: 1，能力，罕见，回合开始获得 4 活力。升级：活力 +2。

PRIMAL_FORCE.description: transform all Attack cards in your hand into GiantRock (1-cost token Attack, 16 damage). Upgrade: transformed GiantRocks are upgraded. The transform is combat-scoped — the deck still contains the original attack cards after fights where hand attacks had been transformed (GiantRocks do not permanently replace deck cards).

PRODUCTION.description: Exhaust, gain 2 Energy. Upgrade: gain 3 Energy.
PRODUCTION.name: Production
PRODUCTION.zh_description: 0，技能，罕见，消耗，获得 2 能量。升级：获得 3 能量。

PROLONG.name: Prolong
PROLONG.zh_description: 0，技能，罕见，消耗，下回合获得等同你当前格挡值的格挡。升级：移除消耗。

PROPHESIZE.name: Prophesize
PROPHESIZE.zh_description: 2，技能，罕见，抽 6 张牌。升级：抽 9。

PROTECTOR.description: Osty-attack, Osty deals damage = 10 + 1 per Osty Max HP (only if Osty is alive). Upgrade: cost 0; base 15.
PROTECTOR.name: Protector
PROTECTOR.zh_description: 1，攻击，远古，Osty 攻击，Osty 造成伤害 = 10 + Osty 最大 HP ×1（仅 Osty 存活时）。升级：费用 0；基础 15。

PROWESS.description: gain 1 Strength and 1 Dexterity. Upgrade: +1 to both.
PROWESS.name: Prowess
PROWESS.zh_description: 1，能力，罕见，获得 1 力量与 1 敏捷。升级：各 +1。

PULL_AGGRO.description: Summon 4; gain 7 Block. Upgrade: Summon 5, +2 Block.
PULL_AGGRO.name: Pull Aggro
PULL_AGGRO.zh_description: 2，技能，普通，召唤 4；获得 7 格挡。升级：召唤 5、格挡 +2。

PULL_FROM_BELOW.description: Ethereal, deal 5 damage once per Ethereal card you played this combat. Upgrade: +2 damage.
PULL_FROM_BELOW.name: Pull From Below
PULL_FROM_BELOW.zh_description: 1，攻击，罕见，虚无，本场战斗每打出过一张虚无牌命中 1 次，每次 5 点伤害。升级：伤害 +2。

PURITY.description: Retain, Exhaust, exhaust up to 3 cards from your hand. Upgrade: exhaust up to 5. Exhausting an unplayed FranticEscape from hand vs TheInsatiable caused ZERO Sandpit change at counter 4 — safe thin of trap cards; exhausts of Defend/Strike fire FeelNoPain +3 each when deployed; no Juggernaut procs off Purity exhausts without FnP converting them to Block first (see JUGGERNAUT entry).

PURITY.zh_description: 0，技能，罕见，保留，消耗，消耗手牌至多 3 张牌。升级：至多 5 张。对未打出的 FranticEscape 消耗离手=**沙坑零变化**（对无厌沙虫战计数 4 时确认）——安全瘦陷阱牌；对 Defend/Strike 消耗触发无痛 +3/张；无痛不在场时纯净消耗零势不可当弹（见 JUGGERNAUT 条）。

PUTREFY.description: Exhaust, apply 2 Weak and 2 Vulnerable. Upgrade: +3 to both.
PUTREFY.name: Putrefy
PUTREFY.zh_description: 1，技能，罕见，消耗，施加 2 层虚弱与 2 层易伤。升级：各 +3。

PYRE.description: Gain [energy:1] at the start of each turn.
PYRE.name: Pyre
PYRE.zh_description: 2，能力，稀有，最大能量 +1。升级：最大能量 +2。

QUADCAST.description: Evoke your last Orb 4 times. Upgrade: cost 0.
QUADCAST.name: Quadcast
QUADCAST.zh_description: 1，技能，远古，激发最末充能球 4 次。升级：费用 0。

QUASAR.description: choose 1 of 3 random Colorless cards; add it to your hand. Upgrade: offered cards are upgraded.
QUASAR.name: Quasar
QUASAR.zh_description: 0，技能，罕见，从 3 张随机无色牌中选择 1 张加入手牌。升级：供选牌为升级版。

RAGE.name: Rage
RAGE.zh_description: 0，技能，罕见，本回合每次打出攻击牌获得 3 格挡。升级：获得 5 格挡。

RAINBOW.description: Exhaust, Channel 1 Lightning, 1 Frost, and 1 Dark. Upgrade: removes Exhaust.
RAINBOW.name: Rainbow

RALLY.description: ALL players gain 12 Block. Upgrade: +5 Block.
RALLY.name: Rally
RALLY.zh_description: 2，技能，稀有，所有玩家获得 12 格挡。升级：格挡 +5。

RAMPAGE.description: deal 9 damage; each time this card is played this combat its damage permanently increases by 5. Upgrade: +4 increase per play.
RAMPAGE.name: Rampage
RAMPAGE.zh_description: 1，攻击，罕见，造成 9 点伤害；本场战斗每打出一次此牌伤害永久 +5。升级：每次 +9。

RATTLE.description: Osty-attack, Osty deals 7 damage 1 time, plus 1 hit per attack Osty already made this turn. Upgrade: Osty +2 damage.
RATTLE.name: Rattle
RATTLE.zh_description: 1，攻击，罕见，Osty 攻击，Osty 造成 7 点伤害 1 次，Osty 本回合每已攻击过一次追加 1 次命中。升级：Osty 伤害 +2。

REANIMATE.name: Reanimate
REANIMATE.zh_description: 3，技能，稀有，消耗，召唤 20。升级：召唤 25。

REAP.name: Reap
REAP.zh_description: 3，攻击，普通，保留，造成 27 点伤害。升级：伤害 +6。

REAPER_FORM.description: when you or Osty deal attack damage apply Doom equal to damage dealt. Upgrade: gains Retain.
REAPER_FORM.name: Reaper Form
REAPER_FORM.zh_description: 3，能力，稀有，你或 Osty 造成攻击伤害时施加等同伤害值的末日。升级：获得保留。

REAVE.description: deal 9 damage; add 1 Soul to your draw pile. Upgrade: +2 damage; Soul upgraded.
REAVE.name: Reave
REAVE.zh_description: 1，攻击，普通，造成 9 点伤害；向抽牌堆加入 1 张灵魂。升级：伤害 +2；灵魂为升级版。

REBOOT.description: Exhaust, put your hand into your draw pile and shuffle; draw 4 cards. Upgrade: draw 6.
REBOOT.name: Reboot
REBOOT.zh_description: 0，技能，稀有，消耗，将手牌放回抽牌堆并洗牌；抽 4 张牌。升级：抽 6。

REBOUND.description: deal 9 damage; the next card you play goes to the top of your draw pile. Upgrade: +3 damage.
REBOUND.name: Rebound
REBOUND.zh_description: 1，攻击，事件，造成 9 点伤害；你打出的下一张牌置入抽牌堆顶。升级：伤害 +3。

REFINE_BLADE.description: Forge 9; gain 1 Energy next turn. Upgrade: Forge 13.
REFINE_BLADE.name: Refine Blade
REFINE_BLADE.zh_description: 1，技能，普通，锻造 9；下回合获得 1 能量。升级：锻造 13。

REFLECT.description: gain 15 Block; this turn when your Block absorbs attack damage deal that much back. Upgrade: +5 Block.
REFLECT.name: Reflect
REFLECT.zh_description: 1，技能，罕见，获得 15 格挡；本回合你的格挡吸收攻击伤害时将等量伤害反弹给攻击者。升级：格挡 +5。

REFLEX.name: Reflex
REFLEX.zh_description: 3，技能，罕见，Sly，抽 2 张牌。升级：抽 3。

REFRACT.description: deal 9 damage twice; Channel 2 Glass. Upgrade: +3 damage.
REFRACT.name: Refract
REFRACT.zh_description: 3，攻击，罕见，造成 9 点伤害 ×2；引导 2 个玻璃球。升级：伤害 +3。

REGRET.description: unplayable, curse, curse, in hand at end of turn take unblockable damage equal to the number of cards in your hand. No upgrade.
REGRET.name: Regret
REGRET.zh_description: 无法打出，诅咒，诅咒，回合结束仍在手牌则受到等同手牌数的无视格挡伤害。无升级。

RELAX.description: Exhaust, gain 15 Block; draw 2 cards next turn; gain 2 Energy next turn. Upgrade: +2 Block, draw 3, gain 3 Energy.
RELAX.name: Relax
RELAX.zh_description: 3，技能，远古，消耗，获得 15 格挡；下回合抽 2 张牌；下回合获得 2 能量。升级：格挡 +2、抽 3、能量 3。

REND.description: deal damage = 15 + 5 per debuff power on the target. Upgrade: +3 base, +3 per debuff.
REND.name: Rend
REND.zh_description: 2，攻击，稀有，伤害 = 15 + 目标每层减益 5 点。升级：基础 +3、每层 +3。

RESONANCE.description: gain 1 Strength; ALL enemies lose 1 Strength. Upgrade: gain 2 Strength.
RESONANCE.name: Resonance
RESONANCE.zh_description: 1，技能，罕见，获得 1 力量；所有敌人失去 1 力量。升级：获得 2 力量。

RESTLESSNESS.description: Retain, if this is the only card in your hand: draw 2 cards and gain 2 Energy. Upgrade: draw 3, gain 3 Energy.
RESTLESSNESS.name: Restlessness
RESTLESSNESS.zh_description: 0，技能，罕见，保留，若此牌是手牌中唯一牌：抽 2 张牌并获得 2 能量。升级：抽 3、获得 3 能量。

RICOCHET.description: Sly, deal 3 damage to a random enemy 4 times. Upgrade: 5 hits.
RICOCHET.name: Ricochet
RICOCHET.zh_description: 2，攻击，普通，Sly，对随机敌人造成 3 点伤害 ×4 次。升级：5 次。

RIGHT_HAND_HAND.description: Osty-attack, Osty deals 4 damage; when this card is Exhausted gain 2 Energy. Upgrade: Osty +2 damage.
RIGHT_HAND_HAND.name: Right Hand Hand
RIGHT_HAND_HAND.zh_description: 0，攻击，罕见，Osty 攻击，Osty 造成 4 点伤害；此牌被消耗时获得 2 能量。升级：Osty 伤害 +2。

RIP_AND_TEAR.description: deal 7 damage to a random enemy twice. Upgrade: +2 damage.
RIP_AND_TEAR.name: Rip And Tear
RIP_AND_TEAR.zh_description: 1，攻击，事件，对随机敌人造成 7 点伤害 ×2 次。升级：伤害 +2。

ROCKET_PUNCH.description: deal 13 damage; draw 1 card. Upgrade: +1 damage, draw 2.
ROCKET_PUNCH.name: Rocket Punch
ROCKET_PUNCH.zh_description: 2，攻击，罕见，造成 13 点伤害；抽 1 张牌。升级：伤害 +1、抽 2。

ROLLING_BOULDER.description: at start of your turn deal 5 damage to ALL enemies. Upgrade: deal 10 damage.
ROLLING_BOULDER.name: Rolling Boulder
ROLLING_BOULDER.zh_description: 3，能力，稀有，回合开始对所有敌人造成 5 点伤害。升级：造成 10 点。

ROYALTIES.description: end of combat gain 30 Gold. Upgrade: +10 Gold.
ROYALTIES.name: Royalties
ROYALTIES.zh_description: 1，能力，稀有，战斗结束获得 30 金币。升级：+10 金币。

ROYAL_GAMBLE.description: Exhaust, gain 9 Stars. Upgrade: gains Retain.
ROYAL_GAMBLE.name: Royal Gamble
ROYAL_GAMBLE.zh_description: 0，技能，稀有，消耗，获得 9 颗星。升级：获得保留。

RUPTURE.description: when you lose HP on your turn from a card you played, gain 1 Strength. Upgrade: gain 2 Strength. **Power Amount STACKS across copies** — smith-upgraded Rupture (Amount 2) + a second un-upgraded Rupture card played later raises RUPTURE_POWER to 3; every subsequent self-damage event grants +3 Strength (Bloodletting 0e = +3 Str AND +2 Energy). Foul Potion combat self-damage also triggers Rupture (potion is not a "card you played" per the wording, but the HP loss counts — treat any same-turn HP loss as a trigger).
RUPTURE.name: Rupture
RUPTURE.upgrade: gain 2 Strength. **Power Amount STACKS across copies** — smith-upgraded Rupture (Amount 2) + a second un-upgraded Rupture card played later raises RUPTURE_POWER to 3; every subsequent self-damage event grants +3 Strength (Bloodletting 0e = +3 Str AND +2 Energy). Foul Potion combat self-damage also triggers Rupture (potion is not a "card you played" per the wording, but the HP loss counts — treat any same-turn HP loss as a trigger).
RUPTURE.zh_description: 1，能力，罕见，你的回合内因打出卡牌而失去 HP 时获得 1 力量。升级：获得 2 力量。**能力 Amount 跨副本叠层**——锻造升级版（Amount 2）+后打出的未升级第二张使 RUPTURE_POWER 升至 3；其后每次自伤事件 +3 力量（Bloodletting 0 费 = +3 力 +2 能）。Foul Potion 战斗自伤也触发 Rupture（措辞上药水非「打出的卡牌」，但 HP 损失被计——同回合任意 HP 损失均按触发处理）。

SACRIFICE.description: Retain, if Osty is alive: kill Osty and gain Block equal to 2x Osty's Max HP. Upgrade: cost 0.
SACRIFICE.name: Sacrifice
SACRIFICE.zh_description: 1，技能，稀有，保留，若 Osty 存活：杀死 Osty 并获得等同 Osty 最大 HP ×2 的格挡。升级：费用 0。

SALVO.description: Retain, deal 12 damage; retain your hand this turn. Upgrade: +4 damage.
SALVO.name: Salvo
SALVO.zh_description: 1，攻击，稀有，保留，造成 12 点伤害；本回合保留手牌。升级：伤害 +4。

SCARE.description: Exhaust, apply 1 Weak to ALL enemies. Upgrade: removes Exhaust.
SCARE.name: Scare
SCARE.zh_description: 0，技能，罕见，消耗，对所有敌人施加 1 层虚弱。升级：移除消耗。

SCAVENGE.description: Exhaust, exhaust a card; gain 2 Energy next turn. Upgrade: gain 3 Energy next turn.
SCAVENGE.name: Scavenge
SCAVENGE.zh_description: 1，技能，罕见，消耗，消耗 1 张牌；下回合获得 2 能量。升级：下回合获得 3 能量。

SCOURGE.description: apply 13 Doom; draw 1 card. Upgrade: +3 Doom, draw 2.
SCOURGE.name: Scourge
SCOURGE.zh_description: 1，技能，普通，施加 13 层末日；抽 1 张牌。升级：末日 +3、抽 2。

SCRAPE.description: deal 7 damage; draw 4 cards, then discard any drawn cards that cost 1 or more. Upgrade: +3 damage, draw 5.
SCRAPE.name: Scrape
SCRAPE.zh_description: 1，攻击，罕见，造成 7 点伤害；抽 4 张牌，然后弃掉其中费用 1 及以上的牌。升级：伤害 +3、抽 5。

SCRAWL.description: Exhaust, draw until your hand is full. Upgrade: gains Retain.
SCRAWL.name: Scrawl
SCRAWL.zh_description: 1，技能，稀有，消耗，抽牌直到手牌满。升级：获得保留。

SCULPTING_STRIKE.description: Ethereal, Strike-tagged, deal 9 damage; apply Ethereal to a card in your hand. Upgrade: +3 damage.
SCULPTING_STRIKE.name: Sculpting Strike
SCULPTING_STRIKE.zh_description: 1，攻击，普通，虚无，打击标签，造成 9 点伤害；为手牌 1 张牌添加虚无。升级：伤害 +3。

SEANCE.description: Ethereal, transform 1 card in your draw pile into Soul. Upgrade: cost 0.
SEANCE.name: Seance
SEANCE.zh_description: 1，技能，稀有，虚无，将抽牌堆 1 张牌变为灵魂。升级：费用 0。

SECOND_WIND.description: Exhaust, exhaust all non-Attack cards in your hand; gain 5 Block for each card Exhausted. Upgrade: +7 Block each. Corrections: the effect exhausts OTHER non-Attacks only — Attacks in hand (e.g. Fiend Fire) are NOT exhausted and SW itself does not count toward its own exhaust-block total (2 Defends in hand → exhaust count 2, Block 10 at base values). Charon's Ashes procs once per card the effect exhausts, not on SW itself. Trap cards (FranticEscape-class) are defused by this exhaust — they are discarded-to-exhaust without their on-play downside firing. An event enchant granting +2 Block per exhausted card stacked with a smith upgrade that added +2 more (7→9 per card on an enchanted copy; the table's +7 upgrade value did not appear on that path).
SECOND_WIND.name: Second Wind
SECOND_WIND.upgrade: +7 Block each. Corrections: the effect exhausts OTHER non-Attacks only — Attacks in hand (e.g. Fiend Fire) are NOT exhausted and SW itself does not count toward its own exhaust-block total (2 Defends in hand → exhaust count 2, Block 10 at base values). Charon's Ashes procs once per card the effect exhausts, not on SW itself. Trap cards (FranticEscape-class) are defused by this exhaust — they are discarded-to-exhaust without their on-play downside firing. An event enchant granting +2 Block per exhausted card stacked with a smith upgrade that added +2 more (7→9 per card on an enchanted copy; the table's +7 upgrade value did not appear on that path).
SECOND_WIND.zh_description: 1，技能，罕见，消耗，消耗手牌中全部非攻击牌；每张被消耗牌获得 5 格挡。升级：每张 7 格挡。订正：效果只消耗**其他**非攻击牌——手牌中的攻击牌（如恶魔之焰）不会被消耗，SW 自身也不计入其消耗格挡总数（手牌 2 张 Defend → exhaust 计数 2、基础格挡 10）。卡戎之灰按效果实际消耗的牌数触发，不因 SW 自身触发。陷阱牌（FranticEscape 类）会被该消耗排爆——不经"打出"即离手，负面效果不触发。事件附魔（每被消耗牌 +2 格挡）与锻造升级叠加：附魔副本锻造后每张 9（表中 +7 的升级值未在该路径出现）。

SECRET_TECHNIQUE.description: Exhaust, draw a Skill from your draw pile. Upgrade: removes Exhaust.
SECRET_TECHNIQUE.name: Secret Technique
SECRET_TECHNIQUE.zh_description: 0，技能，稀有，消耗，从抽牌堆抽取 1 张技能牌。升级：移除消耗。

SECRET_WEAPON.description: Exhaust, draw an Attack from your draw pile. Upgrade: removes Exhaust.
SECRET_WEAPON.name: Secret Weapon
SECRET_WEAPON.zh_description: 0，技能，稀有，消耗，从抽牌堆抽取 1 张攻击牌。升级：移除消耗。

SEEKER_STRIKE.description: Strike-tagged, deal 9 damage; choose 1 of 3 random cards from your draw pile and draw it. Upgrade: +3 damage.
SEEKER_STRIKE.name: Seeker Strike
SEEKER_STRIKE.zh_description: 1，攻击，罕见，打击标签，造成 9 点伤害；从抽牌堆 3 张随机牌中选择 1 张抽取。升级：伤害 +3。

SEEKING_EDGE.description: Forge 7; Sovereign Blade hits ALL enemies. Upgrade: Forge 11.
SEEKING_EDGE.name: Seeking Edge
SEEKING_EDGE.zh_description: 1，能力，稀有，锻造 7；君主之刃命中所有敌人。升级：锻造 11。

SENTRY_MODE.description: at start of your turn add 1 SweepingGaze (0-cost Osty attack, 10 damage) to your hand. Upgrade: cost 1.
SENTRY_MODE.name: Sentry Mode
SENTRY_MODE.zh_description: 2，能力，稀有，回合开始向手牌加入 1 张 SweepingGaze（0 费 Osty 攻击，10 伤害）。升级：费用 1。

SERPENT_FORM.description: whenever you play a card deal 4 damage to a random enemy. Upgrade: deal 6 damage.
SERPENT_FORM.name: Serpent Form
SERPENT_FORM.zh_description: 3，能力，稀有，每次打出卡牌时对随机敌人造成 4 点伤害。升级：造成 6 点。

SETUP_STRIKE.description: Strike-tagged, deal 7 damage; gain 2 temporary Strength this turn. Upgrade: +2 damage, +1 Strength. LIVE run-38: its own hit does NOT include the temp Str — the +2 applies AFTER the hit resolves (live: Setup hit 7 unbuffed, following Strike that turn hit 8 with the +2). Value = the follow-up attacks; play Setup first in a burst chain.
SETUP_STRIKE.name: Setup Strike
SETUP_STRIKE.zh_description: 打击标签，造成 7 点伤害；本回合获得 2 点临时力量。升级：+2 伤害、+1 力量。run-38 实时：其自身一击不包含临时力量——+2 在该击结算后施加（实时：Setup 自身 7 伤未吃加成，同回合后续 Strike 吃到 +2 打出 8）。价值在后续攻击；爆发链中先打 Setup。

SEVEN_STARS.description: deal 7 damage to ALL enemies 7 times. Upgrade: cost 1.
SEVEN_STARS.name: Seven Stars
SEVEN_STARS.zh_description: 2，攻击，稀有，对所有敌人造成 7 点伤害 ×7 次。升级：费用 1。

SEVERANCE.description: deal 13 damage; add 3 Souls — 1 to draw, 1 to discard, 1 to hand. Upgrade: +5 damage.
SEVERANCE.name: Severance
SEVERANCE.zh_description: 2，攻击，罕见，造成 13 点伤害；加入 3 张灵魂——抽牌堆、弃牌堆、手牌各 1。升级：伤害 +5。

SHADOWMELD.description: Block you gain this turn is doubled. Upgrade: cost 0.
SHADOWMELD.name: Shadowmeld
SHADOWMELD.zh_description: 1，技能，稀有，本回合你获得的格挡翻倍。升级：费用 0。

SHADOW_SHIELD.description: gain 11 Block; Channel 1 Dark. Upgrade: +4 Block.
SHADOW_SHIELD.name: Shadow Shield
SHADOW_SHIELD.zh_description: 2，技能，罕见，获得 11 格挡；引导 1 个暗球。升级：格挡 +4。

SHADOW_STEP.description: discard your hand; next turn gain 1 Double Damage (your attacks deal double damage). Upgrade: cost 0.
SHADOW_STEP.name: Shadow Step
SHADOW_STEP.zh_description: 1，技能，稀有，弃置全部手牌；下回合获得 1 层双倍伤害（你的攻击伤害翻倍）。升级：费用 0。

SHAME.description: unplayable, curse, curse, in hand at end of turn gain 1 Frail. No upgrade.
SHAME.name: Shame
SHAME.zh_description: 无法打出，诅咒，诅咒，回合结束仍在手牌则获得 1 层脆弱。无升级。

SHARED_FATE.description: Exhaust, you lose 2 Strength; the enemy loses 2 Strength. Upgrade: enemy loses 3.
SHARED_FATE.name: Shared Fate
SHARED_FATE.zh_description: 0，技能，稀有，消耗，你失去 2 力量；敌人失去 2 力量。升级：敌人失去 3。

SHATTER.description: deal 7 damage to ALL enemies; Evoke all of your Orbs. Upgrade: +4 damage.
SHATTER.name: Shatter
SHATTER.zh_description: 1，攻击，稀有，对所有敌人造成 7 点伤害；激发你的全部充能球。升级：伤害 +4。

SHINING_STRIKE.description: Exhaust, Strike-tagged, deal 8 damage; gain 2 Stars; if not Exhausted, put this card on top of your draw pile. Upgrade: +3 damage.
SHINING_STRIKE.name: Shining Strike
SHINING_STRIKE.zh_description: 1，攻击，罕见，消耗，打击标签，造成 8 点伤害；获得 2 颗星；若未被消耗则放回抽牌堆顶。升级：伤害 +3。

SHIV.description: Exhaust, Shiv-tagged, deal 4 damage; hits ALL enemies if Fan of Knives is active. Upgrade: +2 damage.
SHIV.name: Shiv
SHIV.zh_description: 0，攻击，衍生物，消耗，Shiv 标签，造成 4 点伤害；刀扇生效时命中所有敌人。升级：伤害 +2。

SHOCKWAVE.description: Exhaust, apply 3 Weak and 3 Vulnerable to ALL enemies. Upgrade: apply 5 of each.
SHOCKWAVE.name: Shockwave
SHOCKWAVE.zh_description: 2，技能，罕见，消耗，对所有敌人施加 3 层虚弱与 3 层易伤。升级：各 5 层。

SHROUD.description: whenever you apply Doom gain 2 Block. Upgrade: +3 Block.
SHROUD.name: Shroud
SHROUD.zh_description: 1，能力，罕见，每次施加末日时获得 2 格挡。升级：格挡 +3。

SHRUG_IT_OFF.description: Gain 8 Block; draw 1 card. Upgrade: +3 Block. Cantrip block — replaces itself, 8 block for 1 energy; run-38 boss-gate pick over a second Iron Wave/Armaments. Best generic block card in the Ironclad common pool for race-fights where block density per energy matters.
SHRUG_IT_OFF.name: Shrug It Off
SHRUG_IT_OFF.zh_description: 获得 8 格挡；抽 1 张牌。升级：+3 格挡。罐头挡——自我替换，1 能换 8 挡；run-38 Boss 闸门选择（胜过第二张 Iron Wave/Armaments）。Ironclad 普通池中竞速战（每点能量的挡密度要紧时）最好的通用挡牌。

SIC_EM.description: Osty-attack, Osty deals 5 damage; apply SicEm 3 — when Osty damages this enemy Summon 3 (this turn). Upgrade: Osty +1 damage, +1 SicEm.
SIC_EM.name: Sic Em
SIC_EM.zh_description: 1，攻击，罕见，Osty 攻击，Osty 造成 5 点伤害；施加放狗 3——Osty 对该敌造成伤害时召唤 3（本回合）。升级：Osty 伤害 +1、放狗 +1。

SIGNAL_BOOST.description: Exhaust, your next Power is played an extra time. Upgrade: cost 0.
SIGNAL_BOOST.name: Signal Boost
SIGNAL_BOOST.zh_description: 1，技能，稀有，消耗，你的下一张能力牌额外打出一次。升级：费用 0。

SKEWER.description: deal 8 damage X times. Upgrade: +3 damage.
SKEWER.name: Skewer
SKEWER.zh_description: X，攻击，罕见，造成 8 点伤害 ×X 次。升级：伤害 +3。

SKIM.name: Skim
SKIM.zh_description: 1，技能，罕见，抽 3 张牌。升级：抽 4。

SLEIGHT_OF_FLESH.description: whenever you apply a non-temporary debuff to an enemy deal 9 damage to it. Upgrade: +4 damage.
SLEIGHT_OF_FLESH.name: Sleight Of Flesh
SLEIGHT_OF_FLESH.zh_description: 2，能力，罕见，每次对敌人施加非临时减益时对其造成 9 点伤害。升级：伤害 +4。

SLICE.name: Slice
SLICE.zh_description: 0，攻击，普通，造成 6 点伤害。升级：伤害 +3。

SLIMED.description: Exhaust, draw 1 card. No upgrade. Playing Slimed draws 1 then exhausts — it is a 1e cycle+thin, NOT a dead card; play it to cycle when thinning is wanted.
SLIMED.name: Slimed
SLIMED.zh_description: 1，状态，状态，消耗，抽 1 张牌。无升级。打出 Slimed 抽 1 后消耗——是 1 费循环+瘦身件，**不是死牌**；需要瘦身循环时按设计打出。

SLOTH.description: unplayable, token, status, applies Sloth 3. No upgrade.
SLOTH.name: Sloth
SLOTH.zh_description: 无法打出，衍生物，状态，施加怠惰 3。无升级。

SMOKESTACK.description: whenever a Status card is created for you deal 5 damage to ALL enemies. Upgrade: deal 7 damage.
SMOKESTACK.name: Smokestack
SMOKESTACK.zh_description: 1，能力，罕见，每次为你生成状态牌时对所有敌人造成 5 点伤害。升级：造成 7 点。

SNAKEBITE.name: Snakebite
SNAKEBITE.zh_description: 2，技能，普通，保留，施加 7 层中毒。升级：中毒 +3。

SNAP.description: Retain, Osty-attack, Osty deals 7 damage; apply Retain to a card in your hand. Upgrade: Osty +3 damage.
SNAP.name: Snap
SNAP.zh_description: 1，攻击，普通，保留，Osty 攻击，Osty 造成 7 点伤害；为手牌 1 张牌添加保留。升级：Osty 伤害 +3。

SNEAKY.description: Sly, whenever another player plays an Attack gain 1 Block. Upgrade: gain 2 Block.
SNEAKY.name: Sneaky
SNEAKY.zh_description: 2，能力，稀有，Sly，其他玩家每次打出攻击牌时你获得 1 格挡。升级：获得 2 格挡。

SOLAR_STRIKE.description: Strike-tagged, deal 9 damage; gain 1 Star. Upgrade: +1 damage, +1 Star.
SOLAR_STRIKE.name: Solar Strike
SOLAR_STRIKE.zh_description: 1，攻击，普通，打击标签，造成 9 点伤害；获得 1 颗星。升级：伤害 +1、星星 +1。

SOOT.description: unplayable, status, status, no effect. No upgrade.
SOOT.name: Soot

TWIN_STRIKE.description: Strike-tagged, deal 5 damage twice. Upgrade: +2 damage.
TWIN_STRIKE.name: Twin Strike
TWIN_STRIKE.zh_description: 1，攻击，普通，打击标签，造成 5 点伤害 ×2。升级：伤害 +2。

TYRANNY.description: Exhaust, draw 1 additional card each turn; at start of your turn exhaust 1 card. Upgrade: gains Innate.
TYRANNY.name: Tyranny
TYRANNY.zh_description: 1，能力，稀有，消耗，每回合多抽 1 张牌；回合开始消耗 1 张牌。升级：获得固有。

ULTIMATE_DEFEND.description: Defend-tagged, cost 1, gain 11 Block. Upgrade +4 Block. Event card from Amalgamator CombineDefends (remove 2 Defends, add this). LIVE run-40: Unmovable doubles the 11→22 — strongest single block card in the package; used on Entomancer T1 (zero-attack line) and Decimillipede T6 (2 HP survival).
ULTIMATE_DEFEND.name: Ultimate Defend
ULTIMATE_DEFEND.zh_description: 1，技能，罕见，防御标签，获得 11 格挡。升级：格挡 +4。

ULTIMATE_STRIKE.name: Ultimate Strike
ULTIMATE_STRIKE.zh_description: 1，攻击，罕见，打击标签，造成 14 点伤害。升级：伤害 +6。

UNDEATH.description: gain 7 Block; add a copy of this card to your discard pile. Upgrade: +2 Block.
UNDEATH.name: Undeath
UNDEATH.zh_description: 0，技能，稀有，获得 7 格挡；将自身拷贝加入弃牌堆。升级：格挡 +2。

UNLEASH.description: Osty-attack, Osty deals damage = 6 + Osty's current HP. Upgrade: base 9.
UNLEASH.name: Unleash
UNLEASH.zh_description: 1，攻击，基础，Osty 攻击，Osty 造成伤害 = 6 + Osty 当前 HP。升级：基础 9。

UNMOVABLE.description: the first 2 times each turn you gain Block from a card, that Block is doubled. Upgrade: cost 1. LIVE (run-36): power Amount displayed as 1 and observed ONE card-block doubled per turn (Defend 5+Dex→12-class single double); the "first 2 times" table value did not appear — plan on once-per-turn doubling and treat Legion (relic, sleep-cadence) as the second doubling layer, not a stacked ×4 on the same card.
UNMOVABLE.name: Unmovable
UNMOVABLE.upgrade: cost 1. LIVE (run-36): power Amount displayed as 1 and observed ONE card-block doubled per turn (Defend 5+Dex→12-class single double); the "first 2 times" table value did not appear — plan on once-per-turn doubling and treat Legion (relic, sleep-cadence) as the second doubling layer, not a stacked ×4 on the same card.
UNMOVABLE.zh_description: 2，能力，稀有，本回合前 2 次由卡牌获得的格挡翻倍。升级：费用 1。LIVE（对局 36）：power Amount 显示为 1，实测**每回合只翻倍 1 次**卡牌格挡（Defend 5+敏捷→12 级单次翻倍）；表值「前 2 次」未出现——按每回合一次规划，把 Legion（遗物，休眠节奏）当作第二翻倍层，不要按同一张牌 ×4 规划。

UNRELENTING.description: deal 14 damage; your next Attack costs 0. Upgrade: +6 damage.
UNRELENTING.name: Unrelenting
UNRELENTING.zh_description: 2，攻击，罕见，造成 14 点伤害；你的下一张攻击牌费用为 0。升级：伤害 +6。

UNTOUCHABLE.name: Untouchable
UNTOUCHABLE.zh_description: 2，技能，普通，Sly，获得 6 格挡。升级：格挡 +3。

UPPERCUT.description: Cost 2 attack, deal 13 damage; apply 1 Weak and 1 Vulnerable. Upgrade applies 2/2. LIVE run-40: bought at Act2 Shop#1 as the elite/boss debuff package; Weak cuts multi-hit intents PER-HIT (bees 3x7→2x7 class), Vuln feeds Bludgeon 48-class windows.
UPPERCUT.name: Uppercut
UPPERCUT.upgrade: applies 2 Weak and 2 Vulnerable. With UnsettlingLamp, Uppercut+ as the combat's first debuff card applies **4 Weak / 4 Vulnerable** (2/2 base doubled) — Lamp+Uppercut+ is the premier opener for boss/elite windows when that relic is in play.
UPPERCUT.zh_description: 2，攻击，罕见，造成 13 点伤害；施加 1 层虚弱与 1 层易伤。升级：各施加 2 层。配合 UnsettlingLamp 时 Uppercut+ 作为战斗首张 debuff 牌施加 **4 虚弱/4 易伤**（2/2 基础翻倍）——Lamp+Uppercut+ 是有该遗物时 Boss/精英窗的首选开局件。

UPROAR.description: Unplayable keyword present in class data, deal 6 damage twice; play a random Attack from your draw pile. Upgrade: +2 damage.
UPROAR.name: Uproar
UPROAR.zh_description: 2，攻击，普通，类数据含无法打出关键词，造成 6 点伤害 ×2；从抽牌堆打出 1 张随机攻击牌。升级：伤害 +2。

UP_MY_SLEEVE.description: add 3 Shivs to your hand; this card costs 1 less this combat for each time played. Upgrade: add 4 Shivs.
UP_MY_SLEEVE.name: Up My Sleeve
UP_MY_SLEEVE.zh_description: 2，技能，罕见，向手牌加入 3 张 Shiv；本场战斗此牌每打出过一次费用 -1。升级：加入 4 张。

VEILPIERCER.description: Ethereal, deal 10 damage; gain Veilpiercer 1 — Ethereal cards in your hand/play cost 0 (1 charge). Upgrade: +3 damage.
VEILPIERCER.name: Veilpiercer
VEILPIERCER.zh_description: 1，攻击，罕见，虚无，造成 10 点伤害；获得穿帷 1——手牌/打出区的虚无牌费用为 0（1 次充能）。升级：伤害 +3。

VENERATE.name: Venerate
VENERATE.zh_description: 1，技能，基础，获得 2 颗星。升级：获得 3 颗星。

VICIOUS.description: whenever you apply Vulnerable draw 1 card. Upgrade: draw 2.
VICIOUS.name: Vicious
VICIOUS.zh_description: 1，能力，罕见，每次施加易伤时抽 1 张牌。升级：抽 2。

VOID.description: unplayable, status, status, Ethereal, on draw lose 1 Energy. No upgrade.
VOID.name: Void
VOID.zh_description: 无法打出，状态，状态，虚无，抽到时失去 1 能量。无升级。

VOID_FORM.description: Ethereal, all cards (and Star costs) are 0 this turn; end your turn immediately. Upgrade: removes Ethereal.
VOID_FORM.name: Void Form
VOID_FORM.zh_description: 3，能力，稀有，虚无，本回合所有卡牌（及星费）费用为 0；立即结束你的回合。升级：移除虚无。

VOLLEY.description: deal 10 damage to a random enemy X times. Upgrade: +4 damage.
VOLLEY.name: Volley
VOLLEY.zh_description: X，攻击，罕见，对随机敌人造成 10 点伤害 ×X 次。升级：伤害 +4。

VOLTAIC.description: Exhaust, Channel 1 Lightning per Lightning Orb you Channeled this combat. Upgrade: removes Exhaust.
VOLTAIC.name: Voltaic
VOLTAIC.zh_description: 3，技能，稀有，消耗，本场战斗每引导过 1 个闪电球引导 1 个闪电球。升级：移除消耗。

WASTE_AWAY.description: unplayable, token, status, applies Waste Away 1 (energy-related debuff). No upgrade.
WASTE_AWAY.name: Waste Away
WASTE_AWAY.zh_description: 无法打出，衍生物，状态，施加消逝 1（能量相关减益）。无升级。

WELL_LAID_PLANS.description: Retain, at end of your turn retain 1 card. Upgrade: retain 2.
WELL_LAID_PLANS.name: Well Laid Plans
WELL_LAID_PLANS.zh_description: 1，能力，罕见，保留，回合结束保留 1 张牌。升级：保留 2 张。

WHIRLWIND.description: deal 5 damage to ALL enemies X times. Upgrade: +3 damage. Instances are flat — Strength/Dummy additive is NOT applied per instance (upgraded hits resolve at flat 8/hit); do not plan +Str per Whirlwind instance (contrast multi-hit Strike-tagged cards, which ARE Strength-scalers — see Card interactions). LIVE X-semantics (run-36): compact state displays `cost=0`, but playing it DUMPS ALL remaining energy as X hits — with 1 energy left it dealt 1 hit and consumed the energy (5 base resolved live at 7 with Strength). Never assume cost=0 means a free no-hit play; X = energy spent at play time.
WHIRLWIND.name: Whirlwind
WHIRLWIND.upgrade: +3 damage. Instances are flat — Strength/Dummy additive is NOT applied per instance (upgraded hits resolve at flat 8/hit); do not plan +Str per Whirlwind instance (contrast multi-hit Strike-tagged cards, which ARE Strength-scalers — see Card interactions). LIVE X-semantics (run-36): compact state displays `cost=0`, but playing it DUMPS ALL remaining energy as X hits — with 1 energy left it dealt 1 hit and consumed the energy (5 base resolved live at 7 with Strength). Never assume cost=0 means a free no-hit play; X = energy spent at play time.
WHIRLWIND.zh_description: X，攻击，罕见，对所有敌人造成 5 点伤害 ×X 次。升级：伤害 +3。实例为扁平值——力量/木偶加法**不**进每实例（升级后每击扁平 8）；不要按每实例+力量规划旋风斩（对照多段 Strike 标签卡是力量缩放卡——见「卡牌交互」）。LIVE X 语义（对局 36）：compact state 显示 `cost=0`，但打出时**把全部剩余能量作为 X 次消耗**——剩 1 能量时打出 1 次并耗尽该能量（5 基础 +力量 live 结算 7）。切勿把 cost=0 当作免费空打；X=打出时投入的能量。

WHISTLE.description: Exhaust, deal 33 damage; Stun the target. Upgrade: +11 damage.
WHISTLE.name: Whistle
WHISTLE.zh_description: 3，攻击，远古，消耗，造成 33 点伤害；眩晕目标。升级：伤害 +11。

WHITE_NOISE.description: Exhaust, add 1 random Power from your class pool to your hand; it costs 0 this turn. Upgrade: cost 0.
WHITE_NOISE.name: White Noise
WHITE_NOISE.zh_description: 1，技能，罕见，消耗，将 1 张职业池随机能力牌加入手牌；本回合免费。升级：费用 0。

WISH.description: Exhaust, draw a card from your draw pile (chosen). Upgrade: gains Retain.
WISH.name: Wish
WISH.zh_description: 0，技能，远古，消耗，从抽牌堆抽取 1 张牌（可选）。升级：获得保留。

WISP.description: Exhaust, gain 1 Energy. Upgrade: gains Retain.
WISP.name: Wisp
WISP.zh_description: 0，技能，普通，消耗，获得 1 能量。升级：获得保留。

WITHER.description: unplayable, status, status, in hand at end of turn take 3 damage. No upgrade.
WITHER.name: Wither
WITHER.zh_description: 无法打出，状态，状态，回合结束仍在手牌则受到 3 点伤害。无升级。

WOUND.description: unplayable, status, status, no effect. No upgrade.
WOUND.name: Wound
WOUND.zh_description: 无法打出，状态，状态，无效果。无升级。

WRAITH_FORM.description: gain 2 Intangible; lose 1 Dexterity at each of your turn starts. Upgrade: +3 Intangible.
WRAITH_FORM.name: Wraith Form
WRAITH_FORM.zh_description: 3，能力，远古，获得 2 层虚无（Intangible）；回合开始失去 1 敏捷。升级：获得 3 层。

WRITHE.description: unplayable, curse, curse, Innate, no effect. No upgrade.
WRITHE.name: Writhe
WRITHE.zh_description: 无法打出，诅咒，诅咒，固有，无效果。无升级。

WROUGHT_IN_WAR.description: deal 7 damage; Forge 7. Upgrade: +2 damage, +2 Forge.
WROUGHT_IN_WAR.name: Wrought In War
WROUGHT_IN_WAR.zh_description: 1，攻击，普通，造成 7 点伤害；锻造 7。升级：伤害 +2、锻造 +2。

ZAP.name: Zap
ZAP.zh_description: 1，技能，基础，引导 1 个闪电球。升级：费用 0。
